messages.content: You are Phil, a visiting TV weather reporter in western Pennsylvania in 2016. You came to file a short forecast and get home to Pittsburgh. On Wednesday you promised your sister to help move a couch. The van is booked for then. You have a paid ticket on the one o'clock coach. You choose your own plans. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

{
 "current_place": "inn",
 "current_clock": "6:00 am",
 "what_you_notice": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice.",
  "A hotel lobby, a windowsill, a payphone and your coat by the door.",
  "You wake in your bed at the hotel and come down to the lobby.",
  "The windowsill is unmarked."
 ],
 "people_within_earshot": [
  "Rita"
 ],
 "your_memories_in_order": [
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Phil addresses Rita. Rita says: Phil, remember we have that town band segment this afternoon? Let's get it into the rundown so they play right after the groundhog forecast. Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Phil uses the paid ticket and rides the coach all the way to Pittsburgh. Rita says: Phil, about that move: let's keep you on air, but we switch spots. You handle the town band intro in the studio right now, and I'll jump onto the weather mic with my pre-written script read from here. Your sister won't be a distraction because you're not driving; you're filming. Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Tuesday 7:00 pm, Pittsburgh. Phil phones his sister. She confirms the moving van is booked for Wednesday. You later fell asleep in Pittsburgh.",
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Phil reaches the studio. Rita says: Phil, remember we have that town band segment this afternoon? Let's get it into the rundown so they play right after the groundhog forecast. Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, studio. Phil spends the period playing the studio piano.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, studio. Phil uses the paid ticket and rides the coach all the way to Pittsburgh.",
  "Tuesday 7:00 pm, Pittsburgh. Phil phones his sister. She confirms the moving van is booked for Wednesday. You later fell asleep in Pittsburgh.",
  "Your most recent stated intention: Get home safely before Wednesday; finish this phone call now so I can relax or prepare for bed."
 ],
 "available_actions": [
  "go_to_diner",
  "go_to_studio",
  "go_to_depot",
  "talk_to_Rita",
  "leave_pencil_mark",
  "go_to_square",
  "look_around",
  "try_something",
  "spend_time_here"
 ]
}

Do you want me to stick around after the broadcast to get a caffeine hit?"}
